use_case_summary: AscendRerank is a mid-market marketplace SaaS that wants to add a neural reranking layer on top of an existing vector-search + BM25 pipeline. Primary goals: improve top-k precision (P@1/P@5), enable offline scoring for model selection, and support an online per-request reranker with predictable latency. They plan a two-phase adoption: 1) hosted API POC to validate relevance uplift and cost; 2) Dedicated for sustained traffic, VPC-isolated traffic, and contractual SLAs. Key requirements: support for top-k rerank endpoint, efficient batch offline scoring (S3 ingest), KMS integration, audit logs, and EU data residency options.
